name: Rob Dyrdek
biography: From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia Robert Stanley "Rob" Dyrdek (born June 28, 1974) is an American professional skateboarder, actor, entrepreneur, producer, philanthropist, and reality TV star. He is best known for his roles in the reality shows Rob and Big and Rob Dyrdek's Fantasy Factory.
